# Supported agents

<!-- Generated by scripts/agent-surfaces.ts from src/integrations/registry.ts, src/integrations/workflows.ts and compat/verification.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Tracetoon works across a broad range of coding agents and IDEs. Recommended integrations are actively maintained and continuously compatibility-tested. Community Supported integrations are available on a best-effort basis.

Tracetoon works with 18 coding agents. For a ✅ agent it reads the
session logs the agent keeps on your machine, a PR hook sends the agent's PR
commands (`gh pr create` and the like) to Tracetoon, and the skill is
installed where the agent looks for skills. A 🟡 agent is missing part of
that; the notes below say what. What the two tiers commit to:
[support policy](support-policy.md).

## Recommended integrations

Every new release of these agents is installed and tested by the
compatibility workflow ([how](support-policy.md#how-recommended-integrations-are-verified)). "Last
verified" is the newest release that passed on every listed platform; a newer
release shows as pending, failed or blocked until it passes.

| Agent       | Covers                                | Support                 | PR hook                                   | Last verified    | Newest release   |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------- | ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------- | ---------------- | ---------------- |
| Claude Code | CLI, IDE extensions and desktop app   | ✅ supported             | `~/.claude/settings.json`                 | not yet verified | not yet verified |
| Codex       | CLI, app and IDE extensions           | ✅ supported             | `~/.codex/hooks.json`                     | not yet verified | not yet verified |
| Copilot     | CLI, VS Code agent mode and JetBrains | ✅ supported             | `~/.copilot/hooks/tracetoon.json`         | not yet verified | not yet verified |
| Cursor      | IDE and CLI                           | ✅ supported (see notes) | `~/.cursor/hooks.json`                    | not yet verified | not yet verified |
| OpenCode    | CLI                                   | ✅ supported             | `~/.config/opencode/plugins/tracetoon.js` | not yet verified | not yet verified |

Skill folders: Claude Code `~/.claude/skills/tracetoon`, Codex `~/.agents/skills/tracetoon`, Copilot `~/.agents/skills/tracetoon`, Cursor `~/.agents/skills/tracetoon`, OpenCode `~/.agents/skills/tracetoon`.

## IDE workflows

A recommended workflow is one agent running inside one editor. It doesn't
cover the editor's other agents: Zed's own agent, for example, is Community
Supported. A workflow says "verified" only after its own test has passed.

| Workflow              | What is tested                                                        | Last verified    | Status           |
| --------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- | ---------------- |
| VS Code + Claude Code | the Claude Code extension's bundled CLI (route not built yet)         | not yet verified | candidate        |
| VS Code + Codex       | the Codex extension's bundled CLI (route not built yet)               | not yet verified | candidate        |
| VS Code + Copilot     | Copilot agent mode (runs in the editor window; no headless route yet) | not yet verified | candidate        |
| Zed + Claude Code     | Zed's external-agent (ACP) path to Claude Code                        | not yet verified | not yet verified |
| Zed + Codex           | Zed's external-agent (ACP) path to Codex                              | not yet verified | not yet verified |

## Community Supported integrations

Available and documented, with the same tests on every Tracetoon change, but
not retested on each new release of the agent. Fixes are best-effort, and
contributions are welcome.

| Agent         | Covers                                                     | Support                 | PR hook                                            | Skill folder                        |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| Antigravity   | CLI and IDE                                                | ✅ supported             | `~/.gemini/config/hooks.json`                      | `~/.gemini/config/skills/tracetoon` |
| Factory Droid | Droid CLI                                                  | ✅ supported             | `~/.factory/hooks.json`                            | `~/.agents/skills/tracetoon`        |
| Kilo CLI      | CLI, and Kilo Code for VS Code and JetBrains, which run it | ✅ supported             | `~/.config/kilo/plugins/tracetoon.js`              | `~/.agents/skills/tracetoon`        |
| Kiro          | IDE and CLI                                                | ✅ supported             | `~/.kiro/hooks/tracetoon.json`                     | `~/.kiro/skills/tracetoon`          |
| Cline         | CLI, VS Code and JetBrains extensions                      | ✅ supported (see notes) | `~/.cline/hooks/PreToolUse.mjs`                    | `~/.agents/skills/tracetoon`        |
| Junie         | CLI and JetBrains IDE plugin                               | ✅ supported             | `~/.junie/config.json`                             | `~/.junie/skills/tracetoon`         |
| Devin         | CLI and Devin Desktop, formerly Windsurf                   | ✅ supported (see notes) | inherited: Claude Code's hook, which Devin imports | `~/.agents/skills/tracetoon`        |
| Goose         | CLI and desktop app                                        | ✅ supported             | `~/.agents/plugins/tracetoon/hooks/hooks.json`     | `~/.agents/skills/tracetoon`        |
| Qwen Code     | CLI                                                        | ✅ supported             | `~/.qwen/settings.json`                            | `~/.qwen/skills/tracetoon`          |
| Crush         | CLI                                                        | ✅ supported             | `~/.config/crush/crush.json`                       | `~/.agents/skills/tracetoon`        |
| Amp           | CLI                                                        | 🟡 partial (see notes)  | `~/.config/amp/plugins/tracetoon.ts`               | `~/.agents/skills/tracetoon`        |
| Zed           | Zed Agent                                                  | 🟡 partial (see notes)  | none                                               | `~/.agents/skills/tracetoon`        |
| Warp          | Warp agent                                                 | 🟡 partial (see notes)  | none                                               | `~/.agents/skills/tracetoon`        |

## Notes

- **Cursor:** Cursor's logs don't record exit codes, so the PR can't confirm that tests or builds passed.
- **Cline:** PRs opened through GitHub connector or MCP tools are not redirected; `gh` and other shell commands are. In the VS Code and JetBrains extensions, a blocked PR command stops the task, since their hooks cannot skip a single command; a global Cline rule (~/.cline/rules/tracetoon.md) points the agent to the Tracetoon skill first.
- **Devin:** Devin Desktop runs the Devin CLI engine and keeps its sessions in the same database, so it is read the same way; it has not yet been tested end to end.
- **Amp:** Amp keeps its threads on Amp's servers, so the PR is written from the diff and git history, not session logs. Only PR commands run in the shell are redirected to Tracetoon.
- **Zed:** Zed has no hook before its agent's tools, so a PR command run by the Zed Agent isn't redirected; the agent can still use the Tracetoon skill. Claude Code, Codex and Copilot CLI run inside Zed are covered by their own integrations.
- **Warp:** Warp keeps its agent's replies and file edits on its servers; Tracetoon reads the prompts and the commands the agent ran, from Warp's local database. Warp has no hook before its agent's tools, so a PR command run by Warp's agent isn't redirected; the agent can still use the Tracetoon skill.

`tracetoon integrations` prints the same list for your machine, with the
agents it found. Install routes are in [install.md](install.md).
